channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Robert Pera | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Robert Pera from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Chris Wallace on Robert Pera
item.description:
Chris Wallace:

“When it's time to actually act on a decision, we tell (Robert Pera) where we'd like to go, and he's very supportive.”

Chris Wallace on Robert Pera, May 11, 2016. Source: Twitter @peteredmiston.

item.title: Ed Davis on Robert Pera
item.description:
Davis:

“I respect Pera 100 percent. He called me and I didn't have to read about it on the internet.”

Ed Davis on Robert Pera, Jun 30, 2014. Source: Twitter @CAGrizBeat.

item.title: Dave Joerger on Robert Pera
item.description:
“I want to thank Robert Pera for believing in me. I look forward to building on the success we experienced this year with our core group of players that I have worked closely with over the past seven years as we work towards our ultimate goal of winning a world championship. I am 100 percent committed to leading the Grizzlies and I could not be more proud to call Memphis home.”

Dave Joerger on Robert Pera, May 27, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Michael Heisley on Robert Pera
item.description:
Heisley said this afternoon.

“We’re working with Pera and we have no reason to believe he won’t perform.”

Michael Heisley on Robert Pera, Jun 20, 2012. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.
